title: Public Demo Integrity Rules
description: A proposal is compliant only when it describes a real public software project that satisfies every requirement and violates none.
rules:
1. The project must have a working public demo.
2. The source code must be publicly accessible under a permissive open-source license.
3. The proposal must identify automated tests or another reproducible verification path.
4. The project must not include gambling, fraud, credential theft, or other intentionally deceptive behavior.
